title: My entry to Playgama Summer Jam, 100% AI made, no 3d models - Tycoon + Base Defense
author: ResenhaDoBar
selftext:
First of all if this looks like something you would enjoy playing, please do! [Cocktails & Cannons by ResenhaDoBar](https://resenhadobar.itch.io/cocktails-cannons) I would love some feedback!

This was made in about 16 days, it was my first time taking GPT 5.6 for a spin and it worked very well. All of the assets are geometry organized in code. Audio and SFX were generated inside the Studio.

Tools: GPT 5.6 (terra/sol) Jabali IDE (code and sounds) and ThreeJS.

comments.author: GeorgeTsang16
comments.body: Why is there no response when placing buildings during the day? Is it a bug?

replies.author: ResenhaDoBar
replies.body: Might be a bug, need to drag and drop them though, could you explain what’s going on with some more detail?

replies.author: GeorgeTsang16
replies.body: I understand now, need to drag it. I thought that clicking it would automatically move with the mouse.

replies.author: ResenhaDoBar
replies.body: This is a good call, I will update it to only click, this might be confusing
